Stream emits page and complete events even when some pages fail

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.crawlberg.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() = kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    val engineConfig = mapper.readValue("{\"max_concurrent\":1,\"max_depth\":1}", CrawlConfig::class.java)
    val engine = Crawlberg.createEngine(engineConfig)
    val req = mapper.readValue("{\"url\":\"https://example.com\"}", CrawlStreamRequest::class.java)
    val result = engine.crawlStream(req)
    println(result)
}
```
